brief:
Supply authorities in Khan Younis destroyed approximately 1.25 tons of spoiled frozen foods during an enforcement operation, Shehab Wire reported. The seized products were determined to be unfit for consumption and posed health risks to the public.

The destruction was carried out as part of regular inspections conducted by the supply police to monitor food safety standards and prevent contaminated goods from reaching market shelves. Officials did not disclose additional details about where the frozen items were confiscated or the specific violations discovered during the operation.
